paths.name: react
paths.message: Replace useEffect with the API that matches the job. Derive values during render, handle user actions in event handlers, and reset state with a key. Use TanStack Query for server data, a TanStack Router loader for route data, useSyncExternalStore for subscriptions, or a callback ref for DOM setup and cleanup. For browser APIs, use a library hook such as useMediaQuery for media queries, useEventListener for browser events, useTimeout for a one-shot timer, or useInterval for a repeating timer (all from usehooks-ts). See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect
